subject: [PATCH] sched_ext: Avoid relocking DSQ during remote DSQ moves

reviews.author: Tejun Heo
reviews.summary: Applied the patch to sched_ext/for-7.4 after adjusting its context.
reviews.raw_body:
Applied to sched_ext/for-7.4 with the context adjusted (the patch was
against for-next).

Thanks.

--
tejun

2026-09-23.patch_summary: This patch addresses a double-locking issue in the DSQ (Dynamic Scheduling Queue) move operation, where the source DSQ lock is dropped and then reacquired unnecessarily. The patch proposes calling dispatch_dequeue_locked() instead of deactivate_task() to avoid this redundant lock acquisition.
